chapterInfo.content:
24
Adɛn nti na Onyankopɔn ntea abɔnefoɔ ntɛm so
1Adɛn nti na Otumfoɔ nhyɛ berɛ ntua abɔnefoɔ ka,
na wɔn a wɔni no no nhunu saa berɛ no?
2 # Deut 27.17 Ebinom deɛ wɔtwe ɛhyeɛ,
wɔfom mmoakuo fa yɛne wɔn.
3Wɔka nwisiaa afunumu kɔ,
wɔgye akunafoɔ nantwie awowa.
4Wɔsum ahiafoɔ firi ɔkwan so;
asase so amanehunufoɔ bom hunta.
5Hwɛ, sɛ anwea pradada so mfunumu firi adie no,
saa ara na wɔkɔ wɔn dwumadie so kɔpɛ aduane,
ɛserɛ so na wɔnya aduane ma mmɔfra.
6Mfuo so na wɔtwa mmoa aduane,
na wɔdi ɔbɔnefoɔ bobe turo mu mpɛpɛ.
7Wɔde adagya na ɛda, wɔnni ntoma,
na wɔnni nkataho awɔ mu.
8Mmepɔ so sutorɔ fɔ wɔn,
na ɛnam sɛ wɔnni dwanekɔbea nti,
wɔyɛ ɔbotan atuu.
9Wɔte agyanka firi nufoɔ ano,
na wɔgye mmɔborɔni hɔ awowa.
10 # Yes 58.7 Wɔma wɔnenam adagya a wɔnni ntoma,
na wɔde ɛkɔm soasoa ayuo afiafi.
11 # Yak 5.4 Wɔkyi ngo wɔn afasuo mu,
wɔtiatia nsa-kyi-amena so, nso wɔdi sukɔm.
12Nkuro mu nso na mmarima apinisie fire,
na wɔn a wɔapira wɔn akra su frɛ,
nanso Onyankopɔn mfa n’ani nkari amumuyɛsɛm no.
13Ebinom ayɛ hann anim atuatefoɔ,
wɔnhwɛ n’akwan,
na wɔntena n’atempɔn mu.
14Nhema na owudini sɔreɛ,
ɔkum ɔmanehunufoɔ ne ohiani,
na anadwo ɔyɛ sɛ owifoɔ.
15Na ɔwaresɛefoɔ ani twɛn sum berɛ,
ɔka sɛ: Ani biara renhu me.
Na ɔde nkataho kata n’anim.
16Esum mu na wɔhwirehwire adan mu;
wɔto wɔn ho pono mu awia,
wɔnnim hann.
17Na wɔn nyinaa, esum kabii yɛ wɔn sɛ anɔpa,
ɛfiri sɛ wɔne esum kabii mu ahuyideɛ yɛ nnamfo.
18 # Gye 49.4 Ne ho yɛ hare wɔ nsuo ani;
wɔadome ne kyɛfa asase so,
ɔnnane n’ani nkɔ bobe nturo kwan so.
19Ɔhyeɛ ne ahuhuro na ɛnane sukyerɛmma nsuo,
saa ara nso na Asamando pra wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne kɔ.
20Ɔyafunu a ɛwoo no no werɛ firi no, mmoaa fefe no.
Wɔnkae no koraa bio,
na wɔbɛbubu amumuyɛ sɛ dua.
21Ɔdidii obonini a ɔnwoɔ mpo ho,
na wanyɛ ɔbaa kunafoɔ yie.
22Nanso Onyankopɔn de ne tumi yi atumfoɔ firi hɔ;
wɔtumi nya asetena pa deɛ, nanso wɔnni nkwa ho anidasoɔ biara.
23Ɔma wɔtena hɔ dwoodwoo, na wɔde wɔn ho to ɛno so,
nanso na n’ani hwɛ wɔn akwan.
24Wɔduru deɛ ɛkorɔn, nso kakraa bi pɛ, na wɔnni hɔ;
wɔgyaa mu na wɔsie wɔn sɛ nnipa nyinaa,
na wɔtwitwa wɔn sɛ ayuo mmɛtem.
25Sɛ ɛnte saa a, hwan na ɔbɛyi me ɔtorofoɔ,
na wakyerɛ sɛ m’asɛm no nni mu?

Adɛn nti na Otumfoɔ nhyɛ berɛ ntua abɔnefoɔ ka,
na wɔn a wɔni no no nhunu saa berɛ no?
Ebinom deɛ wɔtwe ɛhyeɛ,
wɔfom mmoakuo fa yɛne wɔn.
Wɔka nwisiaa afunumu kɔ,
wɔgye akunafoɔ nantwie awowa.
Wɔsum ahiafoɔ firi ɔkwan so;
asase so amanehunufoɔ bom hunta.
Hwɛ, sɛ anwea pradada so mfunumu firi adie no,
saa ara na wɔkɔ wɔn dwumadie so kɔpɛ aduane,
ɛserɛ so na wɔnya aduane ma mmɔfra.
Mfuo so na wɔtwa mmoa aduane,
na wɔdi ɔbɔnefoɔ bobe turo mu mpɛpɛ.
Wɔde adagya na ɛda, wɔnni ntoma,
na wɔnni nkataho awɔ mu.
Mmepɔ so sutorɔ fɔ wɔn,
na ɛnam sɛ wɔnni dwanekɔbea nti,
wɔyɛ ɔbotan atuu.
Wɔte agyanka firi nufoɔ ano,
na wɔgye mmɔborɔni hɔ awowa.
Wɔma wɔnenam adagya a wɔnni ntoma,
na wɔde ɛkɔm soasoa ayuo afiafi.
Wɔkyi ngo wɔn afasuo mu,
wɔtiatia nsa-kyi-amena so, nso wɔdi sukɔm.
Nkuro mu nso na mmarima apinisie fire,
na wɔn a wɔapira wɔn akra su frɛ,
nanso Onyankopɔn mfa n’ani nkari amumuyɛsɛm no.

Ebinom ayɛ hann anim atuatefoɔ,
wɔnhwɛ n’akwan,
na wɔntena n’atempɔn mu.
Nhema na owudini sɔreɛ,
ɔkum ɔmanehunufoɔ ne ohiani,
na anadwo ɔyɛ sɛ owifoɔ.
Na ɔwaresɛefoɔ ani twɛn sum berɛ,
ɔka sɛ: Ani biara renhu me.
Na ɔde nkataho kata n’anim.
Esum mu na wɔhwirehwire adan mu;
wɔto wɔn ho pono mu awia,
wɔnnim hann.
Na wɔn nyinaa, esum kabii yɛ wɔn sɛ anɔpa,
ɛfiri sɛ wɔne esum kabii mu ahuyideɛ yɛ nnamfo.

Ne ho yɛ hare wɔ nsuo ani;
wɔadome ne kyɛfa asase so,
ɔnnane n’ani nkɔ bobe nturo kwan so.
Ɔhyeɛ ne ahuhuro na ɛnane sukyerɛmma nsuo,
saa ara nso na Asamando pra wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne kɔ.

Ɔyafunu a ɛwoo no no werɛ firi no, mmoaa fefe no.
Wɔnkae no koraa bio,
na wɔbɛbubu amumuyɛ sɛ dua.

Ɔdidii obonini a ɔnwoɔ mpo ho,
na wanyɛ ɔbaa kunafoɔ yie.
Nanso Onyankopɔn de ne tumi yi atumfoɔ firi hɔ;
wɔtumi nya asetena pa deɛ, nanso wɔnni nkwa ho anidasoɔ biara.
Ɔma wɔtena hɔ dwoodwoo, na wɔde wɔn ho to ɛno so,
nanso na n’ani hwɛ wɔn akwan.
Wɔduru deɛ ɛkorɔn, nso kakraa bi pɛ, na wɔnni hɔ;
wɔgyaa mu na wɔsie wɔn sɛ nnipa nyinaa,
na wɔtwitwa wɔn sɛ ayuo mmɛtem.
Sɛ ɛnte saa a, hwan na ɔbɛyi me ɔtorofoɔ,
na wakyerɛ sɛ m’asɛm no nni mu?

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
